AzureKeyVault.description: Azure Key Vault secret store settings. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Secrets/.

AzureClient.description: The service key of a SecretClient registered by the host, for example 'SecretClient' registered from 'AzureClients:SecretClient'. The feature lazily resolves this shared client; it does not register clients from configuration.

NamePrefix.description: Application namespace prefix used even for single-tenant sites sharing a vault. The readable name is normalized, but the hash and ownership tags preserve the exact prefix. Changing this prefix requires explicit secret migration.
